name: PR list FINDINGS column previews the latest round's findings on hover
description: On the PR list, the FINDINGS column shows compact severity pills per row; hovering the cell opens a read-only popover titled 'N FINDINGS IN THIS RUN' listing the latest review round's findings (severity icon, title, category, file:line, % confidence, clamped rationale — no buttons). Uses the seeded PR #482 (2 findings: 1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING, latest-round previews shipped by GET /repos/:id/pulls). Locator notes: the cell is a role=group carrying the aria-label '2 findings', and `wait --text` matches the CSS-uppercased accessible text ('FINDINGS', 'FINDINGS IN THIS RUN'). Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB — run via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
